_comment: Window types (MCOpening). Lengths in inches or imperial strings. width / height = unit (frame outside) size, sill = unit bottom above the wall base. Any key of mindcanvas/openings/core.py DEFAULTS can be overridden here (nested dicts merge): frame {face, depth, material}, operation fixed | casement | awning | double_hung | sliding, sash {face, depth, material}, mullions {vertical, horizontal, face}, glazing {lites, glass, space, bite, material, spacer}, shim (rough opening clearance), joint (sealant joint at cladding), position weather (frame at the insulation line, default) | brick (frame in the masonry opening, its face `set` in front of the back of the brick), closure {material, thickness, recess} (brick returns), masonry {lintel, bearing, head none|soldier|sailor, sill rowlock|none, sill_slope, sill_projection, flashing, weeps, end_dam, upturn}, trim {liner, stool, stool_projection, material}, sill_pan {...}, head_flashing {...}.

Window - Fixed.label: Fixed window, aluminum frame, insulated glass

Window - Casement.label: Casement window, aluminum frame and sash, insulated glass

Window - Double Hung.label: Double-hung window, wood frame and sashes, insulated glass

Window - Ribbon, 3 Lites.label: Fixed ribbon window, two vertical mullions

Window - Awning with Transom.label: Fixed transom over an awning sash
